scenarios.interface_zh: 连续纹理、形状编码与高对比导视，不要求手机导航。
scenarios.interface_en: Continuous texture, shape coding, and high-contrast signs without phone navigation.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 现场服务员与纸本地图
scenarios.data_zh: 不采集个人轨迹；仅使用人工巡查记录。
scenarios.data_en: No personal traces; only manual inspection records.

scenarios.interface_zh: 可听、可触、可见的过街提示，优先服务低视力与老人。
scenarios.interface_en: Audible, tactile, and visible crossing cues prioritizing low-vision and older users.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 人工交通引导与传统信号
scenarios.fallback_en: Human traffic assistance and conventional signals
scenarios.data_zh: 只记录设备状态，不记录人脸或身份。
scenarios.data_en: Device status only; no face or identity records.

scenarios.interface_zh: 语音、纸本、实体按钮与人工窗口并行，不把二维码设为门槛。
scenarios.interface_en: Voice, print, physical buttons, and a staffed window operate in parallel; QR is never mandatory.
scenarios.data_zh: 敏感事项不进入公共终端；记录最小化。
scenarios.data_en: Sensitive cases stay off public terminals; records are minimized.

scenarios.interface_zh: 用颜色、地面纹理与真人引导连接站口、街角和公共空间。
scenarios.interface_en: Color, ground texture, and human guidance connect station exits, corners, and public space.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 固定时段志愿者与站务协同
scenarios.fallback_en: Scheduled volunteers coordinated with station staff
scenarios.data_zh: 只做匿名问题分类，不保存个体出行档案。
scenarios.data_en: Anonymous issue categories only; no individual travel profiles.

scenarios.interface_zh: 居民可用实体拉环、电话或人工台报告设施故障。
scenarios.interface_en: Residents report faults through a physical pull, phone, or staffed desk.
scenarios.fallback_en: Paper work orders and scheduled inspections
scenarios.data_zh: 只保留位置、故障类型和处理状态。
scenarios.data_en: Only location, fault type, and resolution status are retained.

scenarios.interface_zh: 遮阴、雾化与通风依据环境传感调节，同时保留手动开关。
scenarios.interface_en: Shade, mist, and ventilation respond to environmental sensing with manual controls retained.
scenarios.data_zh: 仅使用温湿度等环境数据。
scenarios.data_en: Environmental data such as temperature and humidity only.

scenarios.interface_zh: 低速机器人在触觉边界和人工观察下测试让行、停靠与异常处置。
scenarios.interface_en: Low-speed robots test yielding, docking, and incident handling within tactile edges and human observation.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 现场安全员可立即接管
scenarios.fallback_en: On-site safety staff can intervene immediately
scenarios.data_zh: 测试日志脱敏；禁止无目的公共影像留存。
scenarios.data_en: Test logs are de-identified; purposeless public imagery retention is prohibited.

scenarios.interface_zh: 与残障体验者共测扶手、语音、触觉与机器人辅助，不以屏幕评分代替现场体验。
scenarios.interface_en: Co-tests handrails, voice, touch, and robotic assistance with disabled participants; screen scores never replace lived experience.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 人工辅助与停止测试权
scenarios.fallback_en: Human assistance and the right to stop testing
scenarios.data_zh: 知情同意、分级授权、可撤回。
scenarios.data_en: Informed consent, tiered authorization, and withdrawal rights.

scenarios.interface_zh: 用实体样本和公开测试卡展示端侧模型的能耗、偏差与失败模式。
scenarios.interface_en: Physical samples and public test cards expose energy use, bias, and failure modes of edge models.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 人工专家复核与纸质报告
scenarios.data_zh: 只使用清权测试集和可审计记录。
scenarios.data_en: Cleared test sets and auditable records only.

scenarios.interface_zh: 把模型卡、代码贡献和风险说明转成可触摸模型、纸本卡片和现场讲解。
scenarios.interface_en: Model cards, code contributions, and risk notes become tactile models, printed cards, and live explanation.
scenarios.data_zh: 只展示公开许可内容并保留署名。
scenarios.data_en: Only openly licensed content is shown with attribution.

scenarios.title_zh: 健康教育法律联合问询桌
scenarios.interface_zh: AI只做公开信息导航；现场人员负责解释、转介和高风险事项。
scenarios.interface_en: AI navigates public information only; staff handle interpretation, referral, and high-risk cases.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 专业人员预约与纸本目录
scenarios.data_zh: 不在开放空间输入病历、学籍或案件隐私。
scenarios.data_en: No medical, education, or legal private records are entered in open space.

scenarios.interface_zh: 以实体徽章、公共桌、步行路线和真人对话组织年度开放活动。
scenarios.interface_en: Physical badges, public tables, walking routes, and live dialogue structure an annual open event.
scenarios.fallback_zh: 现场公告板与社区联络人
scenarios.fallback_en: On-site notice boards and community contacts
scenarios.data_zh: 参与统计仅为聚合计数。
scenarios.data_en: Participation is recorded only as aggregate counts.
